Keep it under 200 beats.How to make it250g tapioca flour250ml milk125ml vegetable oil2 eggs100g parmesan, gratedBring the milk and oil to the boil and pour over the tapioca flour, mixing well.Cool slightly, then beat in the eggs and parmesan to a sticky dough.Roll into balls and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.Cool for a few minutes before serving.Smash green guacamoleChunky smashed avocado with lime, coriander, red onion and green chilli, corn chipsHow to make it3 ripe avocados2 limes, juiced2 tbsp chopped coriander1 red onion, finely diced1 green chilli, choppedsalt, to taste1 bag corn chips, warmedHalve the avocados and smash roughly with a fork, leaving it chunky.Stir in the lime juice, coriander, onion, chilli and salt.Serve straight away with warm corn chips.Rio street beef pastéisStreet food for a run through Rocinha, Bruce's Rio homeHow to make itAs written, serves 4Crisp blistered pastry pockets stuffed with spiced beef mince, olives and egg, fried hot and served with a squeeze of lime and hot sauce.Brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp paprika and salt, then stir in 50g chopped green olives and 2 chopped boiled eggs and cool.Cut 4 thawed puff or spring roll pastry sheets into 12cm squares.Put a spoonful of filling on each, fold into triangles and press the edges with a fork.Fry in oil at 180°C for 3 minutes until blistered.Serve with lime and hot sauce.Chicken coxinhas with limeBruce's Portuguese needs work. Slice the steak and serve with farofa, beans and the vinaigrette.Culver campus pepperoni and mushroom pizzaThe pizzas Bruce uses to get past the guard at CulverHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thin crust blistered in a hot oven, topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni and garlic mushrooms, finished with chilli oil.Divide 1kg pizza dough into 4 and stretch thin.Spread each with 3 tbsp passata mixed with oregano and salt.Fry 200g sliced mushrooms in butter with 1 garlic clove.Top the bases with 400g grated mozzarella, 150g sliced pepperoni and the mushrooms.Bake on a hot tray at 250°C for 10 minutes until blistered.Drizzle with chilli oil.SweetsRocinha chocolate brigadeirosFudgy condensed milk chocolate truffles rolled in chocolate sprinklesHow to make it395g condensed milk2 tbsp cocoa20g butter, plus extra for your hands100g chocolate sprinkles20 small paper casesCook the condensed milk, cocoa and butter over medium-low heat, stirring constantly, until it pulls away from the base in one mass.Tip onto a buttered plate and cool for 1 hour.With buttered hands, roll into 20 small balls and roll in the sprinkles.Sit each in a small paper case.DrinksBottling plant caipirinha, no bloodCachaça muddled with lime and sugar over crushed ice, topped with guaraná sodaHow to make it2 limes3 tbsp caster sugar180ml cachaca240ml cold guarana soda1 bag crushed iceFor each drink, cut half a lime into wedges and muddle hard in a glass with the sugar.Fill with crushed ice, add the cachaca and stir well.Top with cold guarana soda and stir once more.
